title: Mixed Duo #030 · 여 아워글래스 밤쉘·페르시안글램 / 남얼굴 라티나 커브스·그래픽 블랙
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a bright white-sand beach at midday with calm turquoise water, a wooden boardwalk with a waist-high rail and a row of closed striped cabanas of normal door height, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Iranian woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, richly kohl-lined almond eyes, a deep berry-red lip, thick dark brows, warm olive skin, soft pastel-mint-green hair styled in a low chignon knot at the nape, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large gold hoop carrying one heavy rough hammered matte metal weight on gold chain (a gold round bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large gold hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on gold chains of different lengths (a copper small flared temple bell, a copper pyramid-shaped lump, a gold barrel-shaped weight, an iron cube-shaped block), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and four to six layered gold hair ornaments. Extremely long stiletto nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Thai Benjarong porcelain (a black ground with five-colour jewel enamels in lotus-petal motifs), wide gold bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense tiered lotus-petal work filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
LEFT Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on her hip.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme hot-pink platform wedges, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

RIGHT: ONE real adult German person with a handsome man's face on a full, curvaceous female body — a man in his early 30s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a clean-cut young male model face with defined cheekbones, a firm jaw and strong straight brows, a very faint trace of stubble, sharp black graphic eyeliner with matte nude lips and defined contour, fair skin with a neutral undertone, a calm easy look, dark roots fading smoothly into sun-kissed lighter ends (balayage) hair styled in elegant updo, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large platinum hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on platinum chains of different lengths (a copper cube-shaped block, an iron hammer head, an iron barrel-shaped weight, a gold miniature anvil, a silver pyramid-shaped lump), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a single long bronze chain ending in one large faceted pearl-cluster drop with a heavy rough lead a ship's anchor hanging at its end, and a single mixed-metal bracelet. Extremely long round nails, glitter finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: most dramatic hourglass ratio ever, simultaneously maximum enormous bust AND maximum enormous hips both flaring to absolute impossible extremes while the waist is cinched to impossible minimum Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Norwegian rosemaling folk painting (a deep forest-green ground with bold cream and gold acanthus scrollwork), wide gold bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense acanthus scrollwork filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
RIGHT Pose: back three-quarters to camera, head turned back.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme silver platform stiletto corset-lace boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each painted pattern catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
